regression.origin: summarize stored one start/end pair per arm+phase, overwriting earlier repeated windows
regression.distinguishingTest: Two active-1 intervals [10,12] and [20,22] with probe samples at11,15,21. The sample at15 must be excluded; both others included. Two tasks by a1 must remain one distinct agent, with the incomplete task counted failed.
regression.actual: Maintained regression passed with expected values. Before extension reducer rejected active phases; previous static single phase logic overwrote earlier windows.

limitations: Vite source evidence covers 19 repository originals; Python source was measured separately under held edit lock and imported directly by the maintained tests.
Test-runner child substituted four committed helper/config entries; no claim that those helpers ran working-tree bytes.
No fresh-server footprint, provider 50-agent minimum-resource UX, resizing, storage growth, cost qualification or deployed-product acceptance is established.
